timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Did this Gamma Ray burst just point at us?
These stellar explosions are some of the most dangerous phenomena in the universe,
shooting concentrated beams of energy in opposite directions and sterilizing everything in their path.
A scientist recently discovered one that seems to be pointing at Earth.
This is the Wolf-rayed system, two stars orbiting dangerously close to one another and both about to go supernova.
If they collide, they could release a Gamma Ray burst that, given their orientation, might come in our direction.
Thankfully, there are a lot of ifs to that possibility,
and even then, it may take hundreds of thousands of years or more for these stars to even explode and even more to reach Earth.
Thankfully, every Gamma Ray burst ever detected has been detected outside the Milky Way galaxy,
giving ample leeway in case one happened to shoot no direction.
Thought it was in a loop.
